create_map_subclass: create a subclass of Map to define a new StarCraft II map with filename, players, and step_mul attributes
get_map_instance: get an instance of a map by name using the get function from the maps lib
list_all_maps: list all registered map subclasses by calling get_maps to retrieve a dict of map_name to map_class
iterate_map_subclasses: iterate over all subclasses of Map recursively using the all_subclasses classmethod
retrieve_map_data: retrieve map data by calling the data method on a Map instance with a run_config object
